decision_conditions: Gym and Drinking Noise and Hours
description: Large Scale Purpose Built Shared Living (sui generis use) led development, proposals include demolition of the existing buildings, erection of 3 blocks of between 6 and 9 Storeys connected by a 2 storey central building, 331 Shared Living residential units with ancillary communal facilities and amenity spaces to be located at upper floors, flexible town centre (Class E use) units and a drinking establishment (sui generis use) are proposed at ground floor alongside cycle parking, 2x accessible parking bays, and mechanical plant.
